label: GeneratorSmartLoadConfig
info:
Generator And SmartLoad Config - Read & Write

Registers:
- 221-222: Gen timing (R)
- 224-225: Gen charge settings (R/W)
- 229-230: Charge enables (R/W)
- 233,235,237,239: SmartLoad (R/W)
- 278: Bit field - Bit2-3 genPeakShaving, Bit6-7 onGridAlwaysOn (R/W)
- 290: Gen peak shaving power (R/W)
- 292: SmartLoad open delay (R/W)
